previous_assumption: One tsconfig with include: ["src","test"] and no explicit rootDir can serve both `tsc --noEmit` typecheck and the real production `tsc` build.
correction: Without an explicit rootDir, TS infers it as the common ancestor of src+test, so build output split into dist/src/index.js and dist/test/... instead of dist/index.js. Needed a separate tsconfig.build.json (include: src only) for the actual build, keeping the broader src+test tsconfig for typecheck only.
